units: <cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 5:2">Bets. V, 2</cite> <he>ולא מְרַקְּדִין</he> nor dare you dance (on the Sabbath and Holy Days).

<cite ref="Ketubot 16b:4">Keth. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>רִקְּדוּ לפניה</he> (or <he>רָקְדוּ</he>) if there is evidence that they danced before her (at the wedding procession, which proves that she married a virgin).

<cite ref="Ketubot 16b:4">Ib.</cite> bot. <he>כיצד מְרַקְּדִין לפני הכלה</he> what do we sing in her praise when dancing before a bride? <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 20">Num. R. s. 20<sup>11</sup></cite> <he>בשעה … השטן מְרַקֵּד לו וכ׳</he> when a man plans a sin, Satan dances to him (cheering him), until he has done it; a. fr.—V. <cite ref="T00695"><he>רִיקּוּד</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to shake (in the sieve), to sift. Y. Ber. IX, 13ᶜ top; Tosef. Ber. VII (VI), 2. Y. Shebi. V, end, 36ᵃ לא … מַרְקִידִין עמו you must not winnow, or grind, or sift flour together with him.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 7:2">Sabb. VII, 2</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 73a">73ᵃ</cite>) <he>המְרַקֵּד</he> he who sifts flour (on the Sabbath); a. fr.
